name: Snare
description:
Crafting time: Variable.

You prepare a concealed trap that occupies one 5ft x 5ft square for each minute you spend preparing it, up to no more than short range in any dimension.

When a creature enters or begins its turn in the trap area, roll Craft vs Dexterity. On a win, the creature’s speed becomes 0.

On each of its turns, the trapped creature may spend an action to roll Dexterity against your original Craft roll to try to escape.
successes:
✨: The creature must beat your original Craft roll with its Dexterity roll one additional time in order to escape.

🌞: The creature is strangled by the snare and is suffocating.

💀: The trap breaks or fails and has no effect. Check a Condition.
